name: parallel-worker-clones
intent: One job fans three marked clone workers with independent progress bars, then recombines inheriting their identity marks.

reducedMotion.behaviour: Job already complete with all three trait marks inherited

acceptance: Three workers spawn via scale/translate from job (not opacity fade) with marks peak/ring/bars
Bars fill at frozen 300/240/360ms then recombine; job inherits all three marks
Reduced motion shows RECOMBINED job with traits immediately
